title: What If You Stepped Into Quicksand?

scenes.text: What if you stepped into quicksand? You can't be swallowed, but the real trap is worse.
Quicksand is sand soaked with water. Left alone it packs firm. Step in, and it turns liquid.
It's about twice as dense as you are, so you sink only to about the waist.
Then it packs tight. Pulling one foot out takes about the force needed to lift a medium sized car.
Don't yank. Wriggle your legs slowly, so water seeps in and loosens the grains.
The danger was never sinking. It's being stuck, and patience is the way out.
